flows.title: Save a search and view its listings
steps: Select Save this search at the top of the search results page. eBay then emails an alert when new items matching the search are listed.
To see the listings later, go to Saved searches — under Saved on the eBay homepage — and choose View items.
To edit a saved search, select it, add or remove filters, then select Save this search. Editing creates a new saved search with the filters you chose.
To delete a saved search, select the blue heart on it.
